test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: To clear a stock of items, a seller gives an 8% discount on the marked price. He spends ₹x on the promotion of the discount offer. His total cost of the items is ₹2,50,000 and the marked price is 10% more than the cost price. Finally, he earns no profit or no loss. What is the value of x?
solution:
**Given:**

Total cost of items = ₹2,50,000

Marked price is 10% more than the cost price.

Discount on the marked price = 8%

No profit, no loss condition

**Formula Used:**

Marked Price (MP) = Cost Price (CP) + 10% of CP

Discounted Price (SP) = MP - 8% of MP

Total Selling Price (TSP) = Cost Price (CP) + Promotion Cost (x)

**Calculation:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹2,50,000 + 10% of ₹2,50,000

⇒ MP = ₹2,50,000 + 0.10 × ₹2,50,000

⇒ MP = ₹2,50,000 + ₹25,000

⇒ MP = ₹2,75,000

Discounted Price (SP) = MP - 8% of MP

⇒ SP = ₹2,75,000 - 0.08 × ₹2,75,000

⇒ SP = ₹2,75,000 - ₹22,000

⇒ SP = ₹2,53,000

Total Selling Price (TSP) = Cost Price (CP) + Promotion Cost (x)

No profit, no loss ⇒ TSP = SP

⇒ ₹2,50,000 + x = ₹2,53,000

⇒ x = ₹2,53,000 - ₹2,50,000

⇒ x = ₹3,000

**The value of x is ₹3,000.**
